title: 3 Simple Autocrafters for your Farms
description:
With the introduction of new features in 1.16 many of my old simple 1wt autocrafters became outdated. I also figured that a badly produce 20 minute long video is not a great way to introduce simple designs so I've made this short video showcasing some more compact applications of autocrafters for handling farm outputs.
